verdict.rationale: Grok's docs describe adding a custom MCP connector that Grok's servers connect to, with a tunneling guide for exposing local MCP servers via a public URL. A related connectors page covers defining custom tools with your own schemas and logic. Local servers must be publicly reachable, and the evidence shows little of the setup details. Missing for 10: documentation of supported transports, auth and tool-discovery behavior; support for local (stdio) servers without tunneling; independent hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use.
